title: Maps built from the three local Hom comparisons
statement: For the data of [def-pc-perfect-hom-local-comparison] and opens U,V of X, PerfectHomLocalMap(U,V,m) is the inductively generated predicate on functions: a map with a pinned local comparison presentation on U, V or U∩V is basic; the binary product of two generated maps is generated; and conjugation of a generated map by any equivalences of its source and target is generated. There are no other constructors and no invertibility assertions.
